I changed `tax()` in `src/invoice.py` to round half up to the cent, as FIN-12 requires. The test is unchanged.

- **Cause:** `tax()` used `math.floor`, so 112.50 × 0.09 = 10.125 became 10.12. The test expects 10.13.
- **Fix:** It now uses `Decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which avoids float error at exact half-cent values, and returns a float as before.
- **Not verified:** I can't run tests here, so CI is the first check. By my hand calculation, `tax(112.50, 0.09)` returns 10.13.
- **Side effect:** Any other caller relying on floor behavior will now get values up to one cent higher. I didn't search for other callers, so worth a quick check before the 3pm release.
